Topic.label: Identifying misleading features and bias in statistical charts

Question: To prevent a bar chart from being misleading, its vertical axis should generally

Choices.A: Start at any arbitrarily chosen value, as long as it looks good
Choices.B: Have scale intervals that vary in size to emphasize key points
Choices.C: Start at 0 and have evenly spaced scale intervals

Solution: When the vertical axis starts at 0 and has evenly spaced scale intervals, the bar heights are proportional to the values, so differences are neither exaggerated nor diminished.
